In this project, I am working on building a existing mixture model analysis of advice-taking into a metaanalytic model. 

![A posterior predictive distribution of the weight people give their own belief compared to advice. The modes at 0, 0.5, and 1 represent completely declining, perfectly averaging with, and completely adopting the given advice.](advice-taking-metaanalysis.png){width="30%"}
